title: AI-driven Prices for Externalities and Sustainability in Production Markets
abstract: arXiv:2106.06060v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Traditional competitive markets do not account for negative externalities; indirect costs that some participants impose on others, such as the cost of over-appropriating a common-pool resource (which diminishes future stock, and thus harvest, for everyone). Quantifying appropriate interventions to market prices has proven to be quite challenging. We propose a practical approach to computing market prices and allocations via a deep reinforcement learning policymaker agent, operating in an environment of other learning agents. Our policymaker allows us to tune the prices with regard to diverse objectives such as sustainability and resource wastefulness, fairness, buyers' and sellers' welfare, etc. As a highlight of our findings, our policymaker is significantly more successful in maintaining resource sustainability, compared to the market equilibrium outcome, in scarce resource environments.

translated_title: 生产市场中外部性与可持续性的AI驱动定价
translated_abstract: arXiv:2106.06060v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：传统竞争性市场不考虑负外部性；即某些参与者对其他参与者施加的间接成本，例如过度占用公共资源池的成本（这会减少未来的资源存量，从而减少所有人的收获）。量化对市场价格进行适当干预已被证明极具挑战性。我们提出了一种通过深度强化学习政策制定者智能体来计算市场价格和分配的实用方法，该智能体在其他学习智能体的环境中运行。我们的政策制定者允许我们根据多种目标调整价格，例如可持续性和资源浪费、公平性、买卖双方福利等。我们发现的亮点是，在资源稀缺环境中，与市场均衡结果相比，我们的政策制定者在维持资源可持续性方面显著更为成功。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于深度强化学习的政策制定者智能体，通过动态调整市场价格，在资源稀缺环境中显著提升可持续性，优于传统市场均衡结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning-based policymaker agent that adjusts market prices to significantly enhance sustainability in scarce resource environments, outperforming traditional market equilibrium outcomes.
